# dotnet-inspect

A CLI tool for inspecting .NET assemblies and NuGet packages. Useful for understanding package contents, comparing API surfaces between versions, and auditing assemblies for SourceLink/determinism.

## Commands

### package - Inspect NuGet packages

```bash
dotnet-inspect package System.Text.Json                      # Package metadata
dotnet-inspect package System.CommandLine --files            # List DLLs
dotnet-inspect package System.Text.Json --files --all        # List all files
dotnet-inspect package System.CommandLine --versions         # Available versions
dotnet-inspect package System.CommandLine --versions --preview -n 5  # With prereleases, limited
dotnet-inspect package System.Text.Json --deps               # Show dependencies
dotnet-inspect package dotnet-inspect --files --all          # Inspect tool packages
```

### assembly - Inspect .NET assemblies

```bash
dotnet-inspect assembly MyLib.dll                            # Basic info
dotnet-inspect assembly MyLib.dll --audit                    # SourceLink/determinism audit
dotnet-inspect assembly --package System.Text.Json --tfm net8.0  # From package by TFM
dotnet-inspect assembly --package System.CommandLine@2.0.2   # From specific version
dotnet-inspect assembly --package dotnet-inspect             # dotnet-inspect inspecting itself
```

### api - View public API surface

```bash
dotnet-inspect api --package System.CommandLine              # List all types (auto-selects highest TFM)
dotnet-inspect api --package System.Text.Json --tfm net8.0   # Specific TFM
dotnet-inspect api --package Spectre.Console --filter "Progress*"  # Filter types by glob pattern
dotnet-inspect api --package System.Text.Json --filter "*Serializer*"  # Find serializer-related types
dotnet-inspect api JsonSerializer --package System.Text.Json # Specific type
dotnet-inspect api Command --package System.CommandLine@2.0.2  # Specific version
dotnet-inspect api JsonSerializer --package System.Text.Json -m Deserialize  # Filter to member
dotnet-inspect api JsonSerializer --package System.Text.Json -m Serialize -m Deserialize  # Multiple members
dotnet-inspect api JsonSerializer --package System.Text.Json -m Serialize --signatures-only  # Plain signatures
dotnet-inspect api JsonDocument --package System.Text.Json --interfaces  # Show interfaces
dotnet-inspect api Command --package System.CommandLine -m SetAction -v:q  # Quiet mode
dotnet-inspect api JsonSerializer --package System.Text.Json --json --compact  # JSON output
dotnet-inspect api JsonSerializer --package System.Text.Json --all  # Include hidden/obsolete members
dotnet-inspect api CommandLineBuilder --package dotnet-inspect  # dotnet-inspect inspecting itself
```

## Common Workflows

```bash
# Compare API between versions
diff <(dotnet-inspect api JsonSerializer --package System.Text.Json@9.0.12) \
     <(dotnet-inspect api JsonSerializer --package System.Text.Json@10.0.2)

# Compare specific method overloads between versions
diff <(dotnet-inspect api Command --package System.CommandLine@2.0.1 -m SetAction) \
     <(dotnet-inspect api Command --package System.CommandLine@2.0.2 -m SetAction)
```

## Output Formats

- Default: Markdown tables with full method signatures including parameter names
- `--signatures-only`: Plain signatures only (no table formatting, minimal tokens)
- `--json`: JSON output
- `--json --compact`: Minified JSON, omits false/default values

## Output Control (Height × Width)

Output follows a 2D progressive disclosure model:
- **Width** (verbosity): `-v:q` → `-v:d` controls column density
- **Height** (sections): `-s:1,2` (include) or `-x:3` (exclude) controls which sections appear

Verbosity levels:

- `-v:q` - Quiet: summary only
- `-v:m` - Minimal: summary + compact metadata
- `-v:n` - Normal: full sections (default)
- `-v:d` - Detailed: all sections with full tables

## Section Filtering

Filter by H2 section number (1-indexed). Use `-s:1,2` to include or `-x:3` to exclude.

```bash
dotnet-inspect package System.Text.Json -s:1       # Metadata only (exclude dependencies)
dotnet-inspect package System.Text.Json -v:d -s:1  # Detailed metadata only
```

## Tips

- Signatures include parameter names: `void Serialize(Stream utf8Json, TValue value, JsonSerializerOptions options)`
- Version suffix: `System.Text.Json@9.0.12`
- Assembly paths use forward slashes: `lib/net8.0/Foo.dll`
- `--tfm net8.0` selects by target framework; without it, highest TFM is auto-selected
- `-m`/`--member` filter is case-insensitive and shows all matching overloads
- `--filter` uses glob patterns: `*` matches any characters, `?` matches single character
- `--all` includes EditorBrowsable(Never) and Obsolete members (excluded by default)
- Tool packages have executables in `tools/net10.0/any/`; use `--files --all` to explore
- Reads from NuGet cache and caches downloads; use `--verbose` to see cache activity

## Notes on Filtering

By default, the API output excludes:
- Members marked with `[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]`
- Members marked with `[Obsolete]`

Use `--all` to include these members. Note that some libraries expose implementation-detail
methods as public without these attributes; these will still appear in the output.
